entries.claim: A calibrated single-qutrit gate module yields Choi fringe visibilities V(I)=1, V(X)=0, V(Z)=0, V(F3)=1/3.
entries.data_freeze: The first timestamped laboratory raw-count export produced after this registry commit, with its separately timestamped blind key and calibration run.
entries.decision_rule: Pass only if every target is inside its corrected 95% interval and the preregistered residual tolerances are met; otherwise fail.
entries.multiplicity_control: One four-component family; simultaneous Holm correction for the four target residual tests.
entries.notes: Pass 390 is only a synthetic pipeline dry run and supplies no physical evidence.
entries.null_comparator_family: Gate-independent visibility; unconstrained four-visibility model; depolarizing channel with one fitted strength; phase-drift model.
entries.selection_rule: Use the four named gates and four phase settings fixed in analysis/w33_pass390_blinded_choi_visibility_dry_run.py; no gate may be dropped after counts are opened.
entries.uncertainty_propagation: Replicate-level signed cosine visibility, calibration dilution propagated multiplicatively, 95% interval from independent replicate standard error; publish raw counts and calibration.

entries.claim: The finite-geometry expression reproduces alpha^{-1}(0) near 137.036.
entries.data_freeze: A future precision release at preregistered momentum-transfer points, selected before inspecting the release.
entries.decision_rule: Only a prediction fixed before the holdout release can receive prospective status; the alpha(0) match remains retrospective.
entries.multiplicity_control: All momentum points treated as one correlated vector; no choosing the best Q after release.
entries.null_comparator_family: Standard QED/SM running; low-complexity rational approximants with the same number of fitted constants; constant-offset model.

observable.name: inverse fine-structure constant at zero momentum

entries.selection_rule: No retrospective version is eligible. A future test must freeze an independently derived running prescription and predict alpha(Q) at named Q values not used anywhere in construction.
entries.uncertainty_propagation: Full experimental covariance plus theory uncertainty from the fixed running map and threshold inputs.

entries.data_freeze: The next designated global electroweak-coupling fit after all model ingredients and the scale are committed.
entries.decision_rule: The value 3/8 alone is not discriminating; support requires a pre-frozen scale and thresholds outperforming the null family.
entries.multiplicity_control: Count every tried scale, threshold spectrum, and normalization as a separate model in the family.
entries.null_comparator_family: SU(5)-type 3/8 boundary; generic one-scale unification; no-unification SM running; threshold-expanded alternatives with equal parameter count.

observable.name: running weak mixing angle
observable.scale: must be fixed numerically before data comparison

entries.selection_rule: Freeze the renormalization scheme, unification scale, particle content, and threshold corrections before evaluating the target.
entries.uncertainty_propagation: Run the published covariance of gauge couplings through the fixed RG equations and frozen threshold model.

entries.claim: sin^2(theta_W)=3/13 at an electroweak reference scale.
entries.data_freeze: The next independent electroweak global fit after scheme and scale are committed.
entries.decision_rule: A crossing located after looking at the running curve is a fit, not a prediction.
entries.multiplicity_control: Correct over the complete rational family and every previously considered scale.
entries.null_comparator_family: All reduced rationals a/b with 1<=a<b<=20, plus standard SM running without a rational target.
entries.selection_rule: Freeze one named renormalization scheme and one numerical scale; do not choose the scale where the running curve crosses 3/13.
entries.uncertainty_propagation: Use the fit covariance and fixed RG transport; include scheme and threshold uncertainties without refitting the target.

entries.claim: The proposed CKM/PMNS rational-radical angle formulas predict future global-fit central values.
entries.data_freeze: One named future CKM/PMNS global-fit release not used in deriving or selecting any formula.
entries.decision_rule: Evaluate the full vector. A subset match or post-release octant choice is a failure.
entries.multiplicity_control: Familywise correction across every formula present in the repository before the freeze, not only the four retained formulas.
entries.null_comparator_family: Independent free angles; low-denominator rational/radical formulas enumerated before the release; previous-fit persistence model.
entries.selection_rule: Freeze this exact four-component vector, parameter conventions, mass ordering, and octant; no component replacement after release.
entries.uncertainty_propagation: Use the published full covariance matrix; compare the complete residual vector with a chi-square or likelihood ratio.

entries.claim: Mass relations retained in the papers predict future renormalized mass updates.
entries.data_freeze: The next designated independent mass evaluation after the registry entry is fully specified.
entries.decision_rule: No credit for a relation chosen after inspecting the same mass table.
entries.multiplicity_control: Description-length or explicit familywise correction over the full searched relation class.
entries.null_comparator_family: No-relation free masses; generic symmetric quadratic relations; all low-complexity relations searched in the historical corpus.

observable.name: frozen vector of named running masses and derived ratios

entries.selection_rule: List every included particle, scale, scheme, and exact algebraic relation before the holdout update.
entries.uncertainty_propagation: Monte Carlo or linear covariance propagation from the published mass covariance, with scale and scheme uncertainties included.
